conditions: Real angles with cos(a), cos(b), and cos(a+b) nonzero.

evidence: Divide the sine addition identity by the cosine addition identity, then divide numerator and denominator by cos(a)cos(b). The stated nonzero cosine conditions justify both divisions and imply 1-tan(a)tan(b) is nonzero.
